Jev is a decision model, not a text model. You give it unstructured input and a typed question, and you get back a Choice, a Score, or a probability. Nothing else. It cannot invent an option you did not define, which kills a whole class of hallucination. Narrow judgment calls only, and 32k tokens is the practical ceiling for state plus question.
